summary: Approximately 64,594 km² and about 1.8 million people (2026), from Wikidata's Q211 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "Latvia", at revision 1374578921, opens: "Latvia, officially the Republic of Latvia, is a country in the Baltic region of northern Europe. It is one of the three Baltic states, along with Estonia to the north and Lithuania to the south. It borders Russia to the east and Belarus to the southeast and shares a maritime border with Sweden to the west." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 367 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 2 periods of territorial validity, from 1918 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Riga. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
